Android host facts via the Linexa Host Info provider
Android-host identity, CPU, memory, storage, battery, thermal and network — the authoritative source behind every workspace
RootFS storage and live workspace metrics are intentionally NOT shown here — they belong to each workspace\'s own surfaces. This screen reports the Android host only.

the platform withholds this on Android
Android exposes thermal SEVERITY to apps, not per-zone sensor values — CPU/GPU/skin temperatures are hardware-withheld. Battery temperature below is the one real reading.
Positive current usually means discharging; OEM sensors vary.
Modem-reported radio estimate, not a throughput measurement.

Values marked Restricted are blocked by Android security policy for any app — no permission prompt can unlock them. Unavailable means the OS gave no value for that field this cycle. Everything else was genuinely measured by the Host Info provider at the timestamp shown.
